name: forge-desktop
description: Forge governed, local-authority AI workspace for Windows.

scripts.test:integration: pnpm contracts:test && pnpm local:contracts:test && pnpm support:cloud-contracts:test
scripts.test:desktop-e2e: cargo test -p desktop-runtime --test projection_event_fixtures --locked && pnpm --filter @forge/desktop-ui test
scripts.desktop:dev: pnpm exec tauri dev --config crates/desktop-app/tauri.conf.json --features direct-model-providers
scripts.desktop:dev:deterministic: pnpm exec tauri dev --config crates/desktop-app/tauri.conf.json --features deterministic-help
scripts.desktop:build: pnpm exec tauri build --config crates/desktop-app/tauri.conf.json --features deterministic-help
scripts.desktop:build:direct: pnpm exec tauri build --config crates/desktop-app/tauri.conf.json --features direct-model-providers
scripts.poc:check: node packages/bmad-foundation/scripts/source-accounting.mjs --check && node packages/bmad-foundation/scripts/generate-catalog.mjs --check && node --test packages/bmad-foundation/tests/source-accounting.test.mjs packages/bmad-foundation/tests/bmad-capability-catalog.test.mjs packages/bmad-foundation/tests/bmad-spec.test.mjs && node tools/check-workflows.mjs && node tools/check-boundaries.mjs && pnpm --filter @forge/desktop-ui exec vitest run src/features/bmad/__tests__/bmad-capability-catalog.test.tsx src/features/providers/providerValidation.test.ts src/components/settings/SettingsDialog.test.tsx src/components/TaskWorkspace.test.tsx src/components/BmadCapabilityPanel.test.tsx && pnpm --filter @forge/desktop-ui build
scripts.verify:source: pnpm toolchain:check && pnpm ci:policy:test && pnpm ci:reachable && pnpm boundaries:test && pnpm brand:test && pnpm css:conflicts:test && pnpm imports:cycles:test && pnpm recovery:classification:test && pnpm local:contracts:test && pnpm support:cloud-contracts:test && pnpm bmad:foundation:verify && pnpm verify:bmad:source-closure && pnpm verify:bmad:source-meta-tests && pnpm bmad:coverage && pnpm bmad:coverage:test && pnpm contracts:verify:typescript && pnpm secrets:check && pnpm release:test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm verify:boundaries && pnpm css:conflicts && pnpm css:ownership && pnpm imports:cycles && pnpm recovery:classification && pnpm build
scripts.verify:deferred-full: pnpm contracts:verify:cross-language && pnpm secrets:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm verify:boundaries && pnpm rust:fmt && pnpm rust:clippy && pnpm rust:test && pnpm build
